market_scope: x402-list indexed services and monitored facilitators; not full ecosystem
caveats: Provider measurements and rankings are published by x402 List; no independent on-chain re-audit performed.
Distinct buyer addresses are not distinct paying people, enterprises or AgentMine customers.
Concentration includes imported largest-service flow and is not necessarily evidence of end-customer concentration.
Reported 32.8% coverage is of this publisher's measured facilitator flow, not global x402.
Verified delivery means x402 List's verification status, not a verified paid AgentMine customer.
Counts of services/endpoints are catalog supply, not verified demand.
Comparisons with x402stats require scope and deduplication reconciliation.
decision_implication: Basic paid discovery, health monitoring, price benchmarking, buyer-concentration analytics, verified-delivery badges and pay-per-assessment are already offered by an incumbent; do not treat them as unserved AgentMine wedges without new buyer evidence.
